item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: So not only is the Factory much older than I originally thought, but it's run by the personifications of its businesses? This paints them so much more in an eldritch, cosmic horror light than I could've ever imagined. It makes me wonder if the Factory is really all about profit, or if it's for something else inconceivable to human beings, only to the Robber Barons themselves. I mean, a desire for profit only goes so far when it seems like you can basically produce anything in mass quantities, and I'd imagine that such entities would be at this point unimaginably powerful and wealthy. Entertainment, maybe? The satisfaction of seeing so many human souls being crushed and tortured under the ruthless Gilded Age style work environments they create? It's interesting to think about.

item.content:encoded: I agree with this sentiment 100%. I like the Factory as a mysterious, surreal, grotesque entity, a more down-to-earth version of Wondertainment, with the amorality of MC&D and the vagueness of Nobody. It should be cogs, rust, blood-stains and chains, dressed up in a thin veneer of rampant capitalism. This GOI format is good, in as much as it could exist in-universe, but I'd much prefer a little more variety. If the Factory is, in fact, "everything you never knew you wanted, and more", I feel a wider range of formats, interpretations, and documents would go down much better. But hey, that's just me.

item.content:encoded:
I've got some suggestions if you're interested in a coauthor; this is one of my favorite GOI's, and it deserves a strong hub that presents it in all it's twisted vainglory.

For starters, I think the biggest problem with your current approach is this:

I will be addressing the various headcanons in far more detail than the short summaries provided in the current revision without giving any preference to any headcanon above another

The goal of a GOI page is not to summarize numerous versions of a GOI, but to boil them down into their essence, and capture the vibe and spirit of the Factory; the parts that are always there.

+ My take on the Factory:
- A new age of prosperity for all.

The Factory is the solution to all your problems for three easy payments of $19.95.

The Factory is a mighty hammer and sickle.

The Factory is everything you never knew you wanted, and more.

The Factory loves you and wants you to be a happy worker.

The Factory is progress.

The Factory provides.

And the Factory is hiring.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I don't see the style or tone of The Factory on this hub, nor get any actual feeling about them; the fact that the entire first tab is just descriptions about it from other groups makes it much less special. It's a problem I have with the group in general; I don't feel anything about them, I don't feel their style or what makes them stand out to me, and that's reflected in just making the entire first tab about them via other groups, rather than about them from, well, about them.

Of note is that the main page has several GOI formats that explain the nature of the Factory in multiple contradictory ways. This was a conscious decision by myself as the Factory has no real universally agreed upon interpretation, and so each of these formats is representative of a different headcanon that I was able to get summarized for me.

Yes, this is right; but then again, so is (of the groups with hubs): AWCY?, Black Queen, Chaos Insurgency, CotBG, GOC, Nobody, Oneiroi, and Serpent's Hand, yet their hubs reflect a style and essence of the group that captures who/what they are by them, even if it's done in a singular interpretation. This doesn't do that, so it's an extremely unimpressive hub.

About time!

Nitpicking:

Longyan, PROC

If you were going for 'People's Republic of China', it's usually 'PRC'. I don't think 'PROC' was ever in use.

Traditional Chinese

Longyan is in Mainland China (i.e. PRC), which uses Simplified Chinese. The only way Longyan would be using Tradition character is if you were dating this back to before the establishment of the PRC.

Ergo, changing to 'Simplified Chinese' will solve it.

item.content:encoded:
With the approval of Jacob Conwell and Modern_Erasmus, as well as the wonderfully thorough advice of mlister, tretter, DarkStuff, GreenWolf, 9Volt, DrMagnus, Metaphysician, TheDuckman, and several others that i may have forgotten1, the Factory is back in business! I'd like to thank everyone involved; you all wrote this as much as I did.

Of note is that the main page has several GOI formats that explain the nature of the Factory in multiple contradictory ways. This was a conscious decision by myself as the Factory has no real universally agreed upon interpretation, and so each of these formats is representative of a different headcanon that I was able to get summarized for me. As such, no single GOi format is actually the "Correct" interpretation, and none should be treated as such. If you have a headcanon for the Factory that you think should be included here, please PM me with a summary of your headcanon, and I’ll try to add it, provided there are enough GOIs to describe the Factory.

Footnotes
1. PM me if I did forget you
